info.title: Nylorun Management API
info.description: For operators: the Tenant's models, vaults, signing keys, settings and application keys, at `/v1/tenant/*` on the Tenant's URL, through `@nylorun/admin`. Every operation takes a management key, acting as itself: never for a subject and never from a browser. Management keys are issued only on the Tenant's machine (`nylorun key put <id> --management`) or from `NYLORUN_MANAGEMENT_KEY_FILE`.

servers.description: A Runtime: a local Tenant (`nylorun start`), or where yours runs

applicationKey.description: An application key of the Tenant (`PUT /v1/tenant/keys/{keyId}`), or Studio's key, derived from the admin key. With `Nylorun-Subject` and `Nylorun-Scopes`, it acts for that person, narrowed to those scopes. Never accepted from a browser (`Origin`).

managementKey.description: A management key of the Tenant (role `management`): it reaches the Management API (`/v1/tenant/*`) and `/v1/me`, as itself, never for a subject. Issued only on the Tenant's machine (`nylorun-operate keys put <id> --role management`) or from `NYLORUN_MANAGEMENT_KEY_FILE`. Never accepted from a browser (`Origin`).

issuerToken.description: A JWT from a trusted issuer of the Host's identity file (Host feature `trusted-issuers`): one person, with the issuer's scopes, agents and sandbox grants, until it expires. Accepted from servers and browsers alike; CORS is the operator's proxy's.

subject.description: The person the request acts for; absent for an application key alone

sandboxes.description: A token caller's sandbox grants (empty reaches none); absent when no grant limits the caller

post.summary: Check an agent's credentials against vaults
post.description: For each remote MCP server and each HTTP tool with a `credential` that the saved agent `agentId` declares (its own, its agents used as tools' and a flow's), the credential a session that attaches `vaultIds` would send, chosen as a call chooses it: the attached vaults' credentials bound to the URL, then `credentialSelections`. `missing` names the vaults the session could attach that hold one (`available`). The attachment is checked as a session's is: a vault of another person than `ownerUserId` is `403`. No secret is read and no server is called.

403.description: A vault of another person than `ownerUserId`

post.description: Connects to the remote MCP server at `url` with the installation vault's credential for that URL (its headers and `via`; never an identity header), under the Host's address policy, lists its tools within 15 s and closes the connection. It never calls a tool. Each tool comes with the name the model would call it (`modelName`, made with `name`), its annotations and its input schema's size. A server that answers `401` is `authRequired`, with its RFC 9728 protected-resource metadata when it publishes any: it needs a person's sign-in, so reach it through a gateway (`via`), or with a key. No credential value is in the answer.

tags.name: Tenant
tags.description: The Tenant's status, and seeding or resetting it. `admin.tenant` in `@nylorun/admin`.

tags.name: Application keys
tags.description: The keys app servers call the Runtime API with: create, rotate, list and delete them. Management keys come only from the Tenant's machine. `admin.keys`.

tags.name: Models
tags.description: Model providers, their credentials, the model the Tenant uses, what it spent, every model call for export, and the budgets that cap it. `admin.models`.

tags.name: Vaults
tags.description: The installation's and each person's credentials for agents' tools: API keys, bound to the URL they are sent to. Sessions attach a vault by id. `admin.vaults`.

tags.name: MCP servers
tags.description: See a remote MCP server's tools before an agent names it, with the installation vault's credential for its URL: their model names, sizes and annotations, or that it needs a person's sign-in. `admin.mcp`.

tags.name: Signing keys
tags.description: The keys the Runtime signs capability links and run tokens with; their public halves are the Runtime API's JWKS. `admin.signingKeys`.

tags.name: Settings
tags.description: The Tenant's sandbox and artifact settings. `admin.settings`.
